title: Marie Curie
text:
Marie Curie was born in Poland in 1867. She was a scientist. She studied in Paris, in France. She won two Nobel Prizes.

She worked with her husband, Pierre. They studied a special kind of energy called radioactivity. Marie died in 1934.
